payload.reason: The evidence discusses the benefits of pruning a complete graph to improve training efficiency and effectiveness in learning representations.

claims.text: Pruning the complete graph to an arborescence structure allows for more efficient training by focusing on the most relevant connections between mentions and entities.
Models trained with explicit coreference relationships from a pruned graph outperform those that use a fully-connected graph, indicating better performance with pruning.
The pruning process reduces the complexity of the graph, which can lead to improved training outcomes by minimizing noise from irrelevant connections.
